LESSON: COMMON ACCIDENTS EDUCATION

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Safety
Topic 4.1: Common accidents Education

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Common accidents Education
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What causes accidents at (8 lessons) home, electrocution, burns. home?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify ways of preventing sharp edges, slippery floors, accidents at home, vegetable/fruit peelings, broken

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Common accidents Education

Teach
• Observe Common accidents Education in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Common accidents Education (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Common accidents Education.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Common accidents Education.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Common accidents Education.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• identify ways of preventing sharp edges, slippery floors, accidents at home, vegetable/fruit peelings, broken

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Common accidents Education.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Common accidents Education: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What causes accidents at (8 lessons) home, electrocution, burns. home?
2. How can we prevent accidents at home, causes of accidents at home such as accidents at home?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify ways of preventing sharp edges, slippery floors, accidents at home, vegetable/fruit peelings, broken

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
